item.name: Photo to Video
item.prompt: Turn my photo into a video

analysis.one_line_summary: A woman takes a photo of a Toy Story alien, which magically transforms into a lively video where she gains glowing eyes and more toys appear.
analysis.target_viewer: Creative social media users, Toy Story fans, and mobile photographers looking for magical video effects.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A close-up of a Toy Story alien toy with glowing eyes, with a woman's reflection taking a photo.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up of a Toy Story alien toy. A woman is visible in the background taking a photo with her phone.
shot_breakdown.motion: Subtle movement of the toy's eyes and the woman's phone.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The glowing eyes of the toy and the 'behind-the-scenes' feel of taking a photo create immediate curiosity.

shot_breakdown.visual: The scene transitions to the woman at her desk. Her eyes are now glowing green like the alien's.
shot_breakdown.motion: Smooth transition from the toy to the woman's face.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The 'human-to-toy' eye effect is a strong visual hook that signals a magical transformation.

shot_breakdown.visual: The woman interacts with multiple Toy Story characters (Rex, Hamm, Slinky) that appear on her desk.
shot_breakdown.motion: Stop-motion style animation of the toys appearing and moving.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The playful interaction and the 'pop-up' effect of the toys keep the viewer engaged with the fantasy.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The transition from a static 'taking a photo' moment to a high-energy, magical video reality.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Add a clear 'Before' and 'After' label or show the Makaron app interface during the transition to emphasize the tool used.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Stop taking boring photos. Bring them to life with Makaron!
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Start with a split screen: a static photo on the left and the glowing-eye video on the right to immediately show the 'Photo to Video' value proposition.

analysis.one_line_summary: A high-energy, gamified vlog featuring a child exploring Super Nintendo World with video-game-style overlays and UI elements.
analysis.target_viewer: Parents, Nintendo fans, and travel enthusiasts looking for creative ways to document family trips.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A high-energy intro with a 'BOSS DETECTED!' alert and a child wearing a Bowser Jr. hat at Universal Studios Osaka.

shot_breakdown.visual: A child in a Bowser Jr. hat posing in front of a Bowser statue.
shot_breakdown.motion: Static shot with dynamic text overlays appearing.
shot_breakdown.text_or_ui: BOWSER JR. GOES WILD!, BOSS DETECTED!, SOLO MISSION: ACCEPT!
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Uses recognizable Nintendo IP and high-energy 'game start' aesthetics to grab immediate attention.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up of the child rapidly hitting a yellow block.
shot_breakdown.motion: Fast-paced repetitive motion.
shot_breakdown.text_or_ui: MISSION: SMASH THE BLOCK!, Attack Power bar, COMBO!! x88
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Gamification of real-life actions makes the content engaging and satisfying to watch.

shot_breakdown.visual: The child looking up at a giant glowing '?' block.
shot_breakdown.motion: Slight camera tilt upwards to show scale.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Creates a moment of wonder and curiosity, showing the scale of the park.

shot_breakdown.visual: A wide shot of Mario and Luigi mascots interacting with a crowd.
shot_breakdown.motion: Panning shot.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Provides the 'payoff' by showing the iconic characters everyone recognizes.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The use of video game UI elements (health bars, combo counters, mission prompts) to narrate real-life footage.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Replace generic overlays with Makaron-specific animated stickers and 'Game UI' templates to demonstrate the app's editing capabilities.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Turn your family vacation into a real-life video game with just one tap!
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Start directly with the 'COMBO x88' action shot to lead with high energy and movement, then cut to the 'Boss Detected' intro.

item.name: Broadcast Candid
item.prompt: 上传自拍，把你放进棒球比赛的直播画面里

analysis.one_line_summary: A realistic TV broadcast-style clip of a fan reacting enthusiastically at a baseball game, perfect for 'main character' face-swaps.
analysis.target_viewer: Baseball fans and social media users who enjoy 'candid' or 'viral' moments and want to see themselves on TV.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A young woman in a baseball cap looks down at her phone, then suddenly looks up with a shocked, wide-eyed expression.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up of a woman in an LG Twins jersey and red cap looking at her phone. She looks up at the field with a dramatic 'gasp' expression.
shot_breakdown.motion: Subtle head movement from phone to field; eyes widen significantly.
shot_breakdown.text_or_ui: Scoreboard UI (LG 3, Lotte 1), SPOTV LIVE logo.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The sudden, genuine-looking reaction of surprise creates immediate curiosity about what she is seeing.

shot_breakdown.visual: The woman breaks into a huge smile, cheers, and raises her arms in excitement while looking off-camera.
shot_breakdown.motion: High-energy cheering and arm-waving.
shot_breakdown.text_or_ui: Same broadcast UI elements remain static.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The high energy and 'main character' energy make it a highly desirable scene for users to insert themselves into.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The use of authentic broadcast UI (scoreboard, channel logo) to make the scene feel like a real TV moment rather than a filtered video.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Replace the fan's face with the user's selfie while maintaining the realistic lighting and the 'surprised-to-cheering' emotional arc.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: POV: You're the fan everyone's talking about on the live broadcast! ⚾️✨
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Show a split screen: on the left, a user takes a quick selfie; on the right, that selfie is instantly transformed into the woman in the stadium looking up from her phone.

item.name: One-Take
item.prompt: 化身爱豆，置身打歌舞台

analysis.one_line_summary: A high-production K-pop idol stage simulation featuring a pink-haired dancer performing a dynamic 'One-Take' music video routine.
analysis.target_viewer: Gen Z and Millennials interested in K-pop culture, dance challenges, and high-end AI video editing.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A dramatic close-up of the performer's face transitioning into a wide shot of a professional-looking stage with backup dancers.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up of the performer walking towards the camera, followed by a quick zoom-out to reveal the full stage.
shot_breakdown.motion: Forward walk to wide-angle zoom.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The 'idol' aesthetic is instantly recognizable and high-quality, creating immediate visual interest.

shot_breakdown.visual: Medium-wide shot of the choreography with backup dancers and flashing stage lights.
shot_breakdown.motion: Synchronized dance movements with dynamic camera panning.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The professional lighting and backup dancers make the scene feel like a real music video, not just a filter.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up shots during key dance moves, focusing on facial expressions.
shot_breakdown.motion: Fast cuts and camera shakes to match the beat.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Maintains high energy and emphasizes the 'star' quality of the performer.

shot_breakdown.visual: The performer walks forward confidently as the stage lights change, ending with a final pose.
shot_breakdown.motion: Steady forward tracking shot.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The 'ending fairy' trope common in K-pop music shows provides a satisfying conclusion.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The dynamic camera work that stays locked on the subject while the background and lighting shift to create a high-budget music video feel.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Add a 'Before' clip showing the user in a mundane environment (like a bedroom) to emphasize the AI transformation power.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Turn your bedroom into a K-pop stage in one take! 🎤✨
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: A quick 'Before vs. After' flash: 0.5s of the user in a plain room, then 1.5s of the explosive stage reveal with the 'One-Take' effect.

item.name: Character Select
item.prompt: 上传照片，自动生成游戏风格的角色选择动画短片

analysis.one_line_summary: A high-fidelity cyberpunk character selection animation featuring a futuristic bounty hunter with dynamic combat VFX and game-style UI.
analysis.target_viewer: Gamers, sci-fi enthusiasts, and creators looking for high-end AI character transformations.
analysis.first_2_seconds: The character aims a futuristic handgun directly at the camera with a sharp zoom-in effect.

shot_breakdown.visual: Full shot of a cyberpunk character in a neon city, zooming into a close-up as he aims a gun.
shot_breakdown.motion: Rapid zoom and arm movement towards the lens.
shot_breakdown.text_or_ui: NEXUS: 2099 logo in the top left.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Direct eye contact and aggressive action create immediate engagement.

shot_breakdown.visual: Extreme close-up of the gun barrel glowing and firing a bright orange energy blast.
shot_breakdown.motion: High-speed muzzle flash and light bloom effects.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: High-quality VFX and sensory stimulation (light/flash).

shot_breakdown.visual: Side profile of the character firing into the distance with background explosions.
shot_breakdown.motion: Camera shake and particle effects (sparks, smoke).
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Shows the character in a dynamic, 'playable' environment.

shot_breakdown.visual: Character returns to a neutral pose; a futuristic blue UI panel appears with stats.
shot_breakdown.motion: UI elements slide in; character has subtle breathing/idle animation.
shot_breakdown.text_or_ui: Shadowedge, Bounty Class-S, Weapon: ARC-9 Plasma, Status: Active.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Satisfying 'game-ready' aesthetic that makes the user want to 'select' the character.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The sequence of 'Action Hook' -> 'VFX Showcase' -> 'UI/Stat Reveal' to simulate a professional game menu.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Include a 'Before' photo of a real person to demonstrate the AI transformation capability of the app.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Stop playing games and start being in them. Turn your selfie into a Cyberpunk legend.
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Start with a split-screen: A casual selfie on the left and the character aiming the gun on the right, syncing the head tilt.

item.name: Pet Mugshot
item.prompt: 上传宠物照片，生成警局 mugshot 风格的搞笑犯罪档案

analysis.one_line_summary: A dramatic and humorous video featuring a husky 'caught' with snacks, transitioning into a stylized police mugshot profile.
analysis.target_viewer: Pet owners and animal lovers who enjoy humorous, relatable content and creative photo editing templates.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A husky sits intensely behind a table filled with snack bags, looking directly at the camera.

shot_breakdown.visual: Husky dog sitting behind a table with various snack bags. Dark, moody background.
shot_breakdown.motion: Slow zoom in on the dog's face.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Relatable 'guilty pet' scenario combined with high-quality, dramatic lighting creates instant curiosity.

shot_breakdown.visual: Extreme close-up of the husky's bright blue eye.
shot_breakdown.motion: Rapid zoom-in transition.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The fast-paced zoom creates a cinematic 'reveal' effect, building tension for the punchline.

shot_breakdown.visual: The dog is now in a police mugshot setting with a height chart background and a case file overlay.
shot_breakdown.motion: Static image with text appearing.
shot_breakdown.text_or_ui: CASE NO: 2024-HSKY-0428, CRIME: 偷吃零食罪 (Stealing Snacks), DATE: 2024-03-15
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The humorous payoff of the 'criminal' pet trope is highly shareable and satisfying.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The 'crime and punishment' narrative flow: show the 'crime' (pet with food/mess), use a dramatic zoom transition, and reveal the 'mugshot' result.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Add a 'Before' and 'After' label or a UI overlay showing the Makaron template selection to make it clear this is a feature users can use.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Caught red-handed! 🐾 Turn your pet's 'crimes' into hilarious mugshots with one tap.
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Start with a 1-second clip of a pet actually knocking over a treat jar or chewing a shoe, then cut to the intense husky stare to heighten the 'guilty' vibe.

item.name: Pet Action Movie
item.prompt: 上传宠物照片，生成宠物动作大片

analysis.one_line_summary: A high-octane cinematic action sequence featuring anthropomorphic cats in suits engaged in a secret agent heist and fight.
analysis.target_viewer: Pet owners and social media users who enjoy humorous, high-quality AI-generated content and want to see their pets in creative scenarios.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A fluffy cat wearing a suit and a headset opens a high-tech door, whispering 'Target is inside'.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up from behind of a fluffy cat in a black suit and headset opening a modern door with a digital lock.
shot_breakdown.motion: The cat reaches for the handle and pushes the door open.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The absurdity of a cat in a professional suit acting like a secret agent immediately grabs attention.

shot_breakdown.visual: The cat enters a luxury hotel room and spots another cat (black) in a suit by an open safe.
shot_breakdown.motion: Camera follows the cat into the room; the black cat turns around in a defensive stance.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Establishes a clear narrative conflict and high production value.

shot_breakdown.visual: A fast-paced martial arts fight sequence between the two cats in the middle of the room.
shot_breakdown.motion: Dynamic camera movements, punches, blocks, and a final takedown where the fluffy cat pins the black cat.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The high-quality animation of the fight scene is impressive and keeps the viewer engaged to see the outcome.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The concept of placing pets in highly detailed, human-like professional or action roles (e.g., secret agents, chefs, athletes) with cinematic lighting.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Include a 'Before' shot of a static pet photo to demonstrate the transformation power of the Makaron skill.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Ever wondered what your cat does when you're not home? Turn them into a Hollywood action star!
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Start with a split-screen: on the left, a regular photo of a cat; on the right, the cat in the suit opening the door.

item.name: Map Tap Transition
item.prompt: 上传全身照+目的地，生成地图手指点击转场旅行视频

analysis.one_line_summary: A magical vintage map transition that transports users to iconic global landmarks with a single tap.
analysis.target_viewer: Travel enthusiasts, social media influencers, and users looking for creative ways to showcase vacation photos.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A hand taps a 'Milan' pin on a vintage map, triggering a glowing portal that reveals a woman in front of the Milan Cathedral.

shot_breakdown.visual: Vintage map with pins for Paris, Milan, Beijing. A hand taps Milan.
shot_breakdown.motion: Hand movement followed by a circular golden glow expansion.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The tactile interaction with the map creates immediate curiosity about the destination.

shot_breakdown.visual: Transition to a full-body shot of a woman in Milan, then back to the map.
shot_breakdown.motion: Smooth cross-fade transition from the glow to the location photo.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Shows the 'result' of the interaction, proving the creative value of the effect.

shot_breakdown.visual: Hand taps 'Paris' on the map, revealing a woman at the Eiffel Tower.
shot_breakdown.motion: Repeat of the tap-and-glow mechanic.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Demonstrates versatility and encourages users to think about multiple travel memories.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The 'interactive framing' device—using a physical object (the map) to trigger a digital transition to a photo.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Include a UI overlay showing the 'Upload Photo' step to make it feel like a reachable tool rather than just a finished video.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Turn your travel photos into a magical journey with just one tap! 🌍✨
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Start with a split screen: on the left, a folder of travel photos; on the right, the hand tapping the map to instantly 'organize' them into this video.

item.name: Seamless and silky transition
item.prompt: 上传照片，生成丝滑无缝转场视频

analysis.one_line_summary: A seamless zoom transition morphing latte art into a vast desert landscape at sunset.
analysis.target_viewer: Social media content creators, travel enthusiasts, and video editing hobbyists looking for 'wow' effects.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A tight close-up of a coffee cup with latte art, rapidly zooming into the center swirl.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up of a cup of coffee with a heart-shaped latte art pattern.
shot_breakdown.motion: Rapid digital zoom into the center of the foam.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The familiar image of coffee combined with aggressive motion creates immediate curiosity about where the camera is going.

shot_breakdown.visual: The brown and white textures of the coffee foam blur and morph into the ridges of sand dunes.
shot_breakdown.motion: Continuous smooth zoom-out/transition motion.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The 'seamless' nature of the transition is visually satisfying and keeps the viewer engaged to see the final reveal.

shot_breakdown.visual: A wide shot of a desert at sunset with footprints leading into the distance.
shot_breakdown.motion: Slow panning/revealing motion of the landscape.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The contrast between a small cup of coffee and a vast landscape provides a strong emotional 'escape' payoff.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The 'Texture Match' technique: using the color and shape of a small object (coffee foam) to transition into a large-scale environment (sand dunes).
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Add a 'Before' and 'After' UI overlay or a screen recording of the Makaron interface to show how easily the user can upload two photos to generate this result.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Stop scrolling and start creating magic. Turn your everyday photos into cinematic transitions with Makaron.
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Show a hand holding the coffee cup in a normal kitchen setting, then suddenly zoom into the cup to start the transition, making the 'magic' feel more grounded in reality.

item.name: Corridor Breakout
item.prompt: Turn my photo into this 15-second action clip

analysis.one_line_summary: A high-intensity cinematic action sequence featuring a female protagonist fighting through a dark industrial corridor.
analysis.target_viewer: Action movie enthusiasts, gamers, and social media creators looking for high-production value video templates.
analysis.first_2_seconds: A tense moment of a woman leaning against a wall followed by a sudden, athletic leap to grab a ceiling pipe.

shot_breakdown.visual: Woman leaning against a wall in a dark corridor, then jumping up to grab a pipe.
shot_breakdown.motion: Sudden vertical leap and swing.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The sudden transition from stillness to explosive movement creates immediate engagement.

shot_breakdown.visual: Fast-paced combat with a tactical guard using a metal pipe.
shot_breakdown.motion: Rapid cuts, strikes, and blocks.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: High-energy choreography and impactful sound design maintain viewer attention.

shot_breakdown.visual: Close-up of a hand gripping a pipe with water/steam spraying in the background.
shot_breakdown.motion: Static close-up with environmental movement.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Adds cinematic texture and a 'hero' feel to the weapon.

shot_breakdown.visual: Final struggle pinning the guard against a sparking control panel.
shot_breakdown.motion: Aggressive pushing and sparks flying.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: Visual effects (sparks) and high stakes provide a satisfying climax to the fight.

shot_breakdown.visual: Hero shot of the woman with blood on her face, breathing heavily, walking away.
shot_breakdown.motion: Slow zoom and walking away from camera.
shot_breakdown.why_it_hooks: The 'cool factor' of the protagonist's victory provides an emotional payoff for the viewer.

analysis.what_to_copy_as_pattern_not_asset: The 'calm before the storm' opening followed by rapid-fire action and a slow, triumphant ending.
analysis.what_to_change_for_makaron: Insert a 'Before' photo of a regular person at the 0:00 mark with a transition effect to show the transformation into the action hero.
analysis.recommended_ad_hook: Stop posting boring selfies. Turn yourself into a Hollywood action hero in one tap.
analysis.recommended_first_2s_remake: Start with a split-screen: on the left, a static selfie; on the right, the woman jumping from the wall, with a 'Processing...' UI overlay.
